fusions.name: Lockstitch Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a looped strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each leap dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Fettered Together
fusions.desc: Shackles every enemy within 3 tiles to its neighbours. It deals 11 damage and leaves each [Slowed] for 4 seconds, and your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Mail Weave
fusions.desc: Weaves links into a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage, up to 4 blows, and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it.

fusions.name: Each Loop Locks
fusions.desc: Every ability you use adds a link to the one before, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per link (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a link fades every 6 seconds.
